title: Trinity: the first atomic bomb is detonated
summary: Scientists of the Manhattan Project exploded a plutonium bomb in the New Mexico desert, releasing energy equal to about 21,000 tons of TNT.
reason: The United States needed to test the complex implosion design before using such a weapon against Japan.
significance: It began the nuclear age, and the same design was used on Nagasaki three weeks later.
place: Jornada del Muerto desert, New Mexico, United States
